tagline: Sync Notion project dates and deadlines with Google Calendar automatically
metaTitle: Notion Google Calendar Integration: Sync Project Dates
metaDescription: Put Notion project dates and task time blocks on Google Calendar with start and end ranges intact. GAIA links meeting notes to events. See the setup steps.
intro:
Notion is where projects, tasks, and content plans live — complete with due dates and scheduling properties. But those dates stay locked inside, invisible to your calendar and disconnected from how you actually manage your time. GAIA bridges this gap so the timelines you set there automatically appear on your Google Calendar.

Project milestones in your database become Google Calendar events. Content publication dates become deadline reminders. Meeting notes in Notion connect to the calendar events that generated them. Planning and scheduling become one unified workflow.

This integration is especially valuable for content creators, project managers, and product teams who plan extensively in their workspace but need their schedules visible in calendar form.

useCases.title: Sync Notion project dates to Google Calendar
useCases.description: Dates in your project database automatically create calendar events so project milestones, launch dates, and deadlines appear on your calendar without manual entry.

useCases.title: Content calendar integration
useCases.description: Content calendar entries with publication dates sync to the calendar, giving your team a unified view of the content schedule alongside other meetings and commitments.

useCases.title: Calendar time blocks for Notion tasks
useCases.description: GAIA creates calendar focus blocks for tasks with due dates, ensuring you have dedicated calendar time to complete what your task list requires.

useCases.title: Meeting notes linked to calendar events
useCases.description: GAIA connects meeting notes pages to their corresponding calendar events bidirectionally, so clicking a calendar event links directly to the notes page.

useCases.title: Deadline reminders from database items
useCases.description: As deadlines approach for items in your database, GAIA creates calendar reminders so critical dates surface where you check your schedule.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Notion workspace (selecting specific databases) and Google Calendar account. Configure which date properties should sync to the calendar.
Tell GAIA which databases contain schedulable dates, what event titles to use, and which calendar to add events to. Different databases can map to different calendars.

howItWorks.step: Plan once, see everything on your calendar
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors database changes and keeps the calendar updated. Add or change dates and calendar events update automatically within minutes.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync bidirectionally — calendar events back into Notion?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create database entries from calendar events you add, so new meetings appear in your project database automatically with calendar event details as properties.

faqs.question: Does GAIA handle date ranges (start and end dates) in calendar events?
faqs.answer: Yes. Date properties with start and end dates create multi-day calendar events with the correct duration. Single date properties create all-day events or events with a default duration you configure.

faqs.question: Can multiple databases sync to the same calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can sync multiple databases to a single calendar, or map each database to a separate calendar. Having separate calendars per project type is useful for toggling visibility.
